description: Post-orchestrator control-surface registry. The six primary orchestrators, the L12 downstream gate, every subsystem hook family and the safety-critical name-freeze list were removed on 2026-08-25 (branch remove-orchestrators; full pre-removal registry at tag pre-orchestrator-removal). The harness is now: tool-grade skills + generic agents + a small always-on hook set. The evidence kit (qa/appsec SDKs, gate validators and their five agents) was removed on 2026-08-28 — it served the deleted orchestrators and had never produced an evidence directory.
